item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00456","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C25","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Its second section uses the same Bankhead-Jones statutory machinery and a highly similar operative formulation: lands are found suitable for Title III purposes, transferred to Agriculture, and reserved for “use, administration, and disposition” under Title III and the related provisions of Title IV. The child substantially compresses and adapts that formulation to lands already supervised by Agriculture. C25 contains nearly identical machinery and language but is earlier and somewhat less directly aligned with the child's transfer of federal interests to the Secretary of Agriculture. C13 preserves the same operative vocabulary while merely amending prior land-transfer orders.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS I find suitable for the purposes of Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act ... certain lands of the United States","parent_excerpt":"the public lands within the following-described areas, being found suitable for the purposes of Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act","explanation":"Both predicate the land action on an express suitability finding under Title III of the same act."},{"child_excerpt":"all the right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the above-described lands be ... transferred to the Secretary of Agriculture","parent_excerpt":"the jurisdiction thereover is transferred to the Department of Agriculture","explanation":"Both employ a transfer to Agriculture as the central operative mechanism, adapted from jurisdiction over public lands to the United States’ entire interest in nursery lands."},{"child_excerpt":"for use, administration, and disposition in accordance with the provisions of Title III of the said act and the related provisions of Title IV thereof","parent_excerpt":"reserved for use, administration, and disposition in accordance with the provisions of Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act and the related provisions of Title IV thereof","explanation":"This is a distinctive, nearly verbatim statement of the transferred lands’ prescribed legal regime."}]}
